courses.overview: 由海底鏈路、放大器雜訊與維修可靠性連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect submarine links, amplifier noise and repair reliability to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 相干光纖骨幹傳輸
related.why: 可移植「Wet plant 邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from wet-plant boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「Wet plant 邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from wet-plant boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理海底鏈路、放大器雜訊與維修可靠性；「相干光纖骨幹傳輸」主要處理相干接收、DSP 補償與光通道品質，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes submarine links, amplifier noise and repair reliability; Coherent optical backbone transmission emphasizes coherent reception, dsp compensation and optical-channel quality. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「海底光纜通訊系統」與「相干光纖骨幹傳輸」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「非線性累積」的對照方法至「OSNR」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Submarine fiber-optic communications and Coherent optical backbone transmission flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from nonlinear accumulation to optical signal-to-noise ratio, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 低軌衛星網路路由
related.why: 可移植「Wet plant 邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from wet-plant boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「Wet plant 邊界」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from wet-plant boundaries; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理海底鏈路、放大器雜訊與維修可靠性；「低軌衛星網路路由」主要處理時變拓撲、交遞與星間路由，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes submarine links, amplifier noise and repair reliability; Low-Earth-orbit satellite-network routing emphasizes time-varying topology, handover and intersatellite routing. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「海底光纜通訊系統」與「低軌衛星網路路由」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「非線性累積」的對照方法至「接觸預測」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Submarine fiber-optic communications and Low-Earth-orbit satellite-network routing flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from nonlinear accumulation to contact prediction, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

history.year: 公開技術脈絡 / Public technical context
history.title: 光放大海底纜 G.977
history.text: 本課的公開資料脈絡包括「光放大海底纜 G.977」與「海底光纜測試 G.976」。課程把介面和原理改寫為自行設定的對照練習，沒有重製文章、圖像或來源算例。
history.textEn: Public context includes Optically amplified submarine cables G.977 and Submarine cable testing G.976. The course turns interfaces/principles into independently assumed comparisons without reproducing articles, artwork or source examples.
